text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm hm hmm. ♪ It's bath time. ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Ayabe! What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Your hairband... it was on my bed. Try not
to leave it in random
places.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Did I drop it?
I didn't even realize it
was gone. Thanks! ♪ I
would've been
dripping water everywhere after my bath!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey! Since you're here and all, wanna
take a bath too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know you're a shower girlie, but tryouts
are almost here, right? So a
niiice warm
and relaxing bath would be perfect, if you
ask me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh... Hm, too bad I guess.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh. I don't get her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe... we would've been like that too.
If... if you were here...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Would you have... tried to spend time with
me too?

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
"You know those two stars? They made a
wish to the gods, and that's
why they're
together forever."

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe...
If I become a star one day too, do
you think I'll be with you
forever?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Before I even had the words to describe
it, I would sometimes get this
feeling that
someone was beside me—close enough to
touch, yet hopelessly far away.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I looked up at that red star, the
feeling got stronger. So from a young age,
I would sit beneath the starry sky and
talk to that
someone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
When my mother saw me... she would
often force a pained smile.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hrmm... Nnnghhh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You're not going to be able to get up
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know,
but I just can't fall asleep.
You don't have nights like
that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I do, but for different reasons.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah? Hey, since we're insomnia buddies
tonight, why don't we chat
about stuff?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No. Go to bed.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! You're just gonna leave me
hanging, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Quiet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No! Never! Join my gossip sesh right now,
or I'll sneak into your bed!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't do that... Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We can chat... about what, though?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ Okay, okay, we'll go with a
classic...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Your first time running! I wanna hear all
about your memories! ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My first time...

text_block_list.name: Race Organizer
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I know all about your achievements—which is precisely why I'd love to see your daughter in the Pony Cup!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Well, I...
Ayabe, what do you—

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: YES!

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, yes! I... I want to run! I need to run!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I remember it clear as day.
I was always the quiet one, so it was like
someone else
entirely had blurted out that "yes"... My
mother was shocked, to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The Pony Cup! Hehe. So that was your first
race!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How was it, getting a taste of running?
What did you feel in the
moment?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...
I felt...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The turf... its exhilarating scent.
The wind
rushing by, the euphoria of
going farther
and farther.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My heartbeat ringing like an alarm. My
surroundings streaking past,
their vivid
colors like shooting stars...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! S-sorry! It's just, um...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Did I sound like someone else entirely?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: I did it! I really did it! Mom, I won! I won! Hehe... ehehe... Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... sob... Huh? How come I'm... c-crying? I can't... I can't stop!

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why... I... I had so much fun
running. It was like... like I
wasn't me.

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
But now... Now I feel so... alone...
and sad.
Why, Mom? Wh-why?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...The end. The dorm leader should be
coming by on patrol soon.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, but Ayabe—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The end. Now sleep.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Not long after the Pony Cup, my mother
told me the truth.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Listen carefully. You actually... have a
little sister.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
A twin little sister... though she didn't
make it into this world.
